transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, nice to meet you. Um... I guess I'm just having some issues at work. 

Like... I'll start a safety briefing, or I'm looking over a plan review. I try hard to pay attention to it, but... within a few minutes, my mind is just off on three other job problems. And... I end up missing things. Things I know I should've caught. So... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Have you struggled with this kind of focus issue for most of your life, or is this something that has only started happening more recently?

Yeah, it's... it's been a long time. Most of my life, I guess. 

Even back in elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents about it. They'd say I couldn't stay in my seat... or that I talked out of turn. Always losing my homework. And, uh... they said I'd rush through directions before I really understood what I was supposed to do. 

So... yeah. It's not new.
